title: Unit-preserving tensor-to-intrinsic finite pullback comparison
statement: Let $A$ be a finite commutative ring and $f:X\to Y$ a morphism of schemes, in the common universe of the fixed constant-ring realization. Use the actual small pro-etale constant-ring pullback and direct image with their constant-section coefficient maps [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image], the tensor module pullback and its specified unit [def-pur-integral-finite-pullback], and intrinsic fixed-scalar pullback [def-sp-finite-intrinsic-pullback] with its specified direct-image adjunction [def-sp-finite-intrinsic-direct-adjunction]. The tensor and intrinsic right adjoints are identified by their sectionwise identity and the equality of their coefficient maps. Define $e_f:f^*_{\mathrm{tensor}}\xrightarrow{\sim}f^*_{\mathrm{intrinsic}}$ to be the comparison of left adjoints given by $\mathrm{Adjunction.leftAdjointUniq}$ after this identification. Equivalently it is the unique comparison satisfying, for every module sheaf $M$, every site object $V$ and every section $x\in M(V)$, $e_f(u_f V)(\eta^{\mathrm{tensor}}_{f,M,V}(x))=\eta^{\mathrm{intrinsic}}_{f,M,V}(x)$. Define its derived comparison $D(e_f)$ to be the exact termwise localization of this same natural isomorphism. This is a change of coordinates for the canonical pullback, with its adjunction units retained; no exchange theorem or independently chosen natural isomorphism is used.
